card.name: Inside drug names in interaction text
card.fires_on: Partway through a long drug name, on the early or middle piece (e.g. methyl, olic, rif, vinc, ef, pro), usually in drug-interaction or concomitant-use sentences.

modes.label: Early piece of a drug name
modes.description: The first piece of a drug name that is still unfinished, such as rif or vinc.
modes.example: simultaneous co-administration of atorvastatin with<< rif>>ampin is recommended

modes.label: Middle piece of a drug name
modes.description: A middle piece of a multi-part drug name, such as olic in mycophenolic acid.
modes.example: reduce the dose of concomitantly administered mycophen<<olic>> acid products as needed

card.writes: It promotes the word 'related' and its Chinese equivalents, which suggests it predicts forms like 'drug-related' after a name.
card.plain: It lights up in the middle of a long drug name, often in sentences about drugs given together.
